svg.title: CREBEE Gateway Pro product details
svg.desc: Standalone gateway for TELICA ESL systems with built-in CREBEE software, capacity for up to 3,000 compatible labels, and a two-year factory warranty. Wireless coverage is up to 98 feet with a clear line of sight and varies with the environment.

g.text: Add or replace a gateway in a TELICA ESL system.
Built-in CREBEE software. No monthly CREBEE
Manage compatible labels with or without POS integration.
Up to 3,000 compatible TELICA labels per gateway.
Up to 98 ft (30 m) with a clear line of sight.
Actual coverage varies with store layout and
2-year factory warranty for the Gateway Pro.
Product details may change. Confirm when ordering.
